fusions.name: Cold Weight
fusions.desc: Hurls a dense clot of locusts at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, dealing 14 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach, and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Corroding Cloud
fusions.desc: The swarm gnaws at every enemy within 3 tiles, dealing 8 damage and leaving them 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Unyielding Mass
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier of packed bodies that absorbs the next 22 damage and holds for 8 seconds, and raises your armour by 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Hardened by Blows
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once and you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (56% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
